source: Create a multiplayer fighting game. Build a flat city arena map with concrete ground, destructible walls, a few tall buildings, and small tree around the edges

image_prompt.text: Concrete walls across the arena floor that fracture under fire, so cover degrades as the fight goes on
Standing walls and columns on the concrete floor that let a retreating fighter break line of sight
Gaps between the wall clusters that funnel fighters together into predictable flashpoints
Spawns set back at the arena edges, screened by the tall buildings so a player is not in a firing line the frame they appear
a flat concrete ground plane for the whole arena floor
a few tall city buildings standing around the edges of the arena
small trees dotted around the perimeter

layout_placement.text: Anti-camp spawn placement at the arena edges for each side

notes: Shape is answered by the prompt: flat is stated, so no tiered or multi-level option was considered and the map stays P0.
choke-bottleneck and cover-los came from the preset. The prompt only names destructible walls, so if those walls are the only vertical geometry the arena is emptier than the preset implies.
Player count and win condition are not stated - the prompt says multiplayer fighting and nothing more.

open_questions.ask: Assumed a block-scale arena of roughly 100-500 studs - how many fighters is the floor meant to hold at once?
Is this last-man-standing, round-based, or free-for-all with respawns? The win condition changes whether spawns and lock-in gates are needed.
Are the tall buildings climbable, or purely edge dressing? Making them enterable or walkable adds real generation cost.

theme: Modern Urban - concrete, asphalt and contemporary city buildings

answers.ask: Assumed a block-scale arena of roughly 100-500 studs - how many fighters is the floor meant to hold at once?
answers.answer: Support up to 8 fighters at once; keep the arena compact and readable for that player count.

answers.ask: Is this last-man-standing, round-based, or free-for-all with respawns? The win condition changes whether spawns and lock-in gates are needed.
answers.answer: Use a free-for-all with respawns, with no round lock-in gates.

answers.ask: Are the tall buildings climbable, or purely edge dressing? Making them enterable or walkable adds real generation cost.
answers.answer: The tall buildings are purely edge dressing and should not be enterable or climbable.
